finding: The previous velocity-corrected wall-traction source omitted the isotropic -w_i(u dot F)/cs^2 term. Its first moment was the requested force, but its zeroth moment was (u dot F)/cs^2 instead of zero.
secondary_finding: The solver-agnostic wall path also divided the already-integrated wall traction by y_val a second time. It now uses the same unit lattice wall-area/control-volume scaling as the mature BFL wall path.
corrected_source: w_i * ((c_i dot F - u dot F)/cs^2 + (c_i dot u)(c_i dot F)/cs^4)

regression_tests.command: wall-model moment/closure suites plus solver-agnostic wall_function_common and LBMStepExecutor regression suites

campaign_policy.pre_correction_resistance_results: stability and diagnostic evidence only; not eligible for physical promotion
campaign_policy.checkpoint_without_scheme: rejected instead of silently resuming with changed wall physics
campaign_policy.first_corrected_three_level_generation: v13 baseline / v14 inlet-sponge A-B pair

scope_limit: Moment consistency removes a spurious mass source. It does not by itself validate the Musker law, local refinement, open boundaries, SUBOFF drag, or experimental agreement.
